title: Blend AI denoise tiles in float32 and restore whole-image colour
source: rapidroom (adapted AGPL open-photo-ai tiling/wavelet and GPL-3.0-or-later CalibRaw reflection)
notes: Best/Fast and legacy NIND use normalized raised-cosine overlaps, float32 accumulation and whole-image five-level B3-spline colour restoration. Legacy NIND uses periodic mirror padding, rejects invalid model outputs, and clips only at image encoding. Best/Fast caches use a new pipeline identity. Changes affect explicitly denoised images; default renders bypass this path. Model-specific noise estimation and post-demosaic grain return remain deferred under issue 172.
